en.text: Did you really think I would help you?
Did you really think I'd help you?

original: 彼を助けました。

en.text: I helped him.
We helped him.

original: 「助けて。助けて」と叫んでいました。

en.text: "Help, help," she shouted.

original: 「助けて。助けて」と泣き叫んでいました。

en.text: "Help, help," she cried.

original: 助けたら、手伝ってくれる？

en.text: If I help you, will you help me?
